observations.what_it_proves: P3066 is an active 1,864 MW Load request in Clearwater County with POI 38-Caroline; developer is not exposed.
P3066 appears as a 1,864 MW Data Load in the Caroline planning area at Stage 2 / assessment, with ISD under review.
The Caroline planning area has 1,864 DTS MW across 2 projects and lists P3066 as Data Load; substation/POI context is not a facility coordinate.

do_not_infer: Clearwater County is not a parcel
POI 38-Caroline is not the facility address
1,864 MW is not measured electricity or IT load
secondary data-center classification is not developer/owner proof

observations.what_it_proves: P3198 is listed as an 1,800 MW Data Load in Fort Saskatchewan, Stage 1 / assessment, ISD under review.
P3198 appears in the Fort Saskatchewan planning area alongside the 439S substation context; this does not establish a parcel.
P3198 is one of 45 current Alberta data-load projects and was detected as newly listed in August 2026.

do_not_infer: Fort Saskatchewan planning area is not a parcel
substation association is not physical-site identity
Data Load is not measured electricity
no developer name is not evidence of concealment
